channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Lyle graduate awarded 2026 young leaders scholarship from MNICCA
item.description: Lyle grad Cayden Goslee earns 2026 MNICCA Scholarship for leadership and commitment to agriculture, and will study precision agriculture at South Dakota State University.

item.title: In Your Community: Shriners deliver toys to Twin Cities
item.description: Austin Shrine Club delivers toys to Shrine HealthCare for Children in the Twin Cities, including a Barbie with a prosthetic leg, using a trailer donated by Kuehn Motors of Austin.

item.title: Republican Qualls picks fellow businessman Nicholson to fill out Minnesota governor ticket
item.description: Minnesota GOP hopeful Kendall Qualls taps fellow businessman Brian Nicholson as his running mate, creating an all-political-newcomer ticket in a crowded governor’s race.

item.title: Young musicians celebrated at Harris Music Contest Concert & Awards Ceremony
item.description: Young musicians perform in a free Harris Music Contest Concert & Awards Ceremony, March 7 at 4 p.m. in Austin High School’s Knowlton Auditorium.

item.title: Public input requested on fisheries management plans for 197 lakes
item.description: Minnesota DNR seeks public input by March 31 on 2026 fisheries management plans for 197 lakes; residents are asked to contact area offices with comments.

item.title: Gas prices jump in Minnesota as Middle East conflict widens
item.description: Minnesota gas prices jump 17 cents overnight to about $3 a gallon, driven by a widening Middle East conflict and seasonal shift to more costly summer-blend fuel.

item.title: Expanded Message
item.description: Pheasants Forever chapter president holds a broad vision for the good the restarted organization can do in Mower County

item.title: Blue Devil Dynasty: Riverland prepares for its fourth trip to nationals in the last five years
item.description: Riverland men’s basketball heads to its fourth NJCAA DIII national tournament in five years, chasing the program’s first title behind a deep frontcourt in Herkimer, N.Y.

item.title: Lewiston-Altura knocks off Grand Meadow boys
item.description: Lewiston-Altura, the No. 3 seed, defeated No. 6 Grand Meadow 85-53 in a Section 1A quarterfinal at Mayo Civic Auditorium, ending GM’s season at 18-10.

item.title: Blooming Prairie boys eliminated in Blue Earth
item.description: No. 12 Blooming Prairie boys season ends with 74-48 Section 2AA quarterfinal loss at No. 5 Blue Earth Area, finishing 18-9.
